{07 14 00}I'm just wondering, because
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}

{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} {07 0b 00}kas sulle meeldib

{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Fishing can be really
exciting,{01 00 00 0f 00} {04 1f 00}.
Especially now, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}That's only because
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00} are
in season.
You can catch them
at sea if you go out
{04 10 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kalapüük võib olla väga
põnev,{01 00 00 0f 00} {04 1f 00}.
Eriti praegu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Ja seda ainult sellepärast,
et {0b 02 00}{04 1a 00} on
hooajal.
Neid saab püüda

{04 10 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I can't explain it, but I am
SO into fishing right now,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Did you know the elusive
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00} is
in season, right now?
{07 14 00}Trust me, just cast your
rod into a pond
{04 10 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma ei oska seletada, aga ma
olen PRAEGU nii kalapüügi
lainel, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Kas sa teadsid, et tabamatu
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00} on
praegu hooajal?
{07 14 00}Usu mind, viska lihtsalt
õng tiiki
{04 10 00}!

messages.en:
So, {04 1f 00}, {07 0b 00}have you
been fishing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 00 00}You should go look in a
river, because you may see
{04 1a 00}!
{07 16 00}They're tricky little fish
to catch, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
Or is it just me?

Nii, {04 1f 00}, {07 0b 00}kas sa oled
kalal käinud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 00 00}Mine jõe äärde vaatama,

{04 1a 00}!

püüda, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

See on aasta aeg, mil mu
sõbrale {04 0b 00}le

{07 04 00}{04 0b 00} püüdis
{04 1a 00}
eelmisel aastal merest!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 06 00}Kui ma sel aastal ühte ei
püüa, siis ma ei ela seda
üle, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
